Open faculty search,

The Computer Science and Engineering Department of the Instituto Superior Técnico (ULisboa) is carrying out an open search process for possible candidates to future openings for faculty career positions. This open search is targeted at possible candidates who have an interest in enrolling at the base level of the university professional career (assistant professor), in all scientific areas of the Department, namely:

- Artificial Intelligence
- Computer systems, architecture, and networking
- Graphics and Interaction (including human-computer interaction)
- Information Systems
- Programming Methodology and Technology

Open Faculty Search 2026-2027 - Departamento de Engenharia Informática tecnico.ulisboa.pt

Candidates should fill the application form HERE, with the following material.

>

Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications; One-page motivation letter; Teaching and research statement; Contact (including email address) of three researchers or professionals from the area, who can be contacted to provide reference letters, attesting to the scientific, pedagogical, and professional qualities of the possible candidate. The candidates will be expected to:

Develop a strong and independent research career with national and international recognition; Develop a research program, which is capable of attracting competitive funding at the national and international level; Supervise undergraduate, MSc and PhD students; Contribute to both undergraduate (BSc) and graduate (MSc and PhD) teaching programs; Carry out other service activities as a faculty member, by interacting collegially and maintaining the highest standard of integrity and ethics.

DEADLINE; full consideration will be given to the materials received by October 16th, 2026. However, applications are evaluated as they are received.. For any additional questions please contact the Department at dei@tecnico.ulisboa.pt <
